title: Prior Lost or Stolen Replacements — Program Integrity Note
content:
Earlier lost or stolen overrides on a member's Pharmacy Benefit coverage shorten a new lost or stolen replacement.

**Rule.** The prior-replacement adjustment counts the lost or stolen overrides granted on the coverage for any drug in the last twelve months: minus three days for two or more, minus two days for exactly one, and nothing for none.

The overrides counted are the lost or stolen early refill overrides in the member's pharmacy requests on the coverage, of any drug, dated in the last twelve months. The adjustment is added to the replacement base days, and the replacement days are never fewer than one day after it.

| Lost or stolen overrides on the coverage, last twelve months | Prior-replacement adjustment |
|---|---|
| Two or more | Minus 3 days (a signed adjustment of -3) |
| Exactly one | Minus 2 days (a signed adjustment of -2) |
| None | Nothing |

*Cases (hypothetical):* one lost or stolen override for another drug ten months ago gives minus 2 days; one fourteen months ago is outside the twelve months and gives nothing.
